description:
Allows for marking up/drawing on notes in the Samsung Notes app (designed for use with S Pen).
Removal likely breaks com.samsung.android.app.notes. Safe to remove otherwise.
May reinstall itself automatically (removal has persisted for me this time around, and through multiple reboots).
